Common pitfalls

What to avoid

  • Deploying agents without comprehensive evaluation on edge cases.
  • Relying solely on the LLM for safety without external guardrails.
  • Not monitoring agent behavior continuously after deployment.

Code example

Build an agent evaluation framework

advanced coding

Create a framework for evaluating agent task completion. Define test cases with expected outcomes, implement success metrics, and measure cost efficiency.

What to notice

  • Task success = fraction of expected output phrases present
  • Action accuracy checks both precision (no wrong tools) and recall (all needed tools used)
  • Budget compliance is a hard pass/fail on steps and tokens

Expected outcome

Dict with task_success=1.0, action_recall=1.0, within_budget=True

Starter code

Reference solution 
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class AgentTestCase:
    name: str
    input_query: str
    expected_actions: List[str]
    expected_output_contains: List[str]
    max_steps: int
    max_tokens: int

@dataclass
class AgentResult:
    output: str
    actions_taken: List[str]
    steps: int
    tokens_used: int
    duration_ms: float

class AgentEvaluator:
    def __init__(self):
        self.results = []

    def evaluate(self, test_case: AgentTestCase, result: AgentResult) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # Task success: output contains expected phrases
        output_lower = result.output.lower()
        phrases_found = sum(1 for p in test_case.expected_output_contains if p.lower() in output_lower)
        task_success = phrases_found / len(test_case.expected_output_contains) if test_case.expected_output_contains else 1.0

        # Action accuracy: did it use the right tools?
        expected_set = set(test_case.expected_actions)
        actual_set = set(result.actions_taken)
        action_precision = len(expected_set & actual_set) / len(actual_set) if actual_set else 0
        action_recall = len(expected_set & actual_set) / len(expected_set) if expected_set else 1.0

        # Budget compliance
        within_steps = result.steps <= test_case.max_steps
        within_tokens = result.tokens_used <= test_case.max_tokens

        score = {
            "task_success": task_success,
            "action_precision": action_precision,
            "action_recall": action_recall,
            "within_budget": within_steps and within_tokens,
            "efficiency": 1.0 - (result.steps / test_case.max_steps)
        }
        self.results.append(score)
        return score

    def summary(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        if not self.results:
            return {}
        keys = self.results[0].keys()
        return {k: sum(r[k] for r in self.results) / len(self.results) for k in keys if isinstance(self.results[0][k], (int, float))}
